name: Environmental Health
notes: Prerequisites of individual courses are not counted toward the major.
Students may major, minor, OR complete a cluster within the public health-related programs, but not more than one.
No more than two courses may overlap between a public health major and another major.
STAT 212 was valid until spring 2024; STAT 180 is the current course.
Several electives carry validity windows or class-year restrictions noted on the department page.

NEEDS VERIFICATION: the four electives are grouped into themes (Biology and Health Sciences, choose three, plus a further theme); the later themes were truncated in the captured page, so electives are modeled as biology/environmental courses.
CHEM 207 is a one-credit lab accompanying CHEM 203.

requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Public Health General Core (Four Courses): PHLT 101: Introduction to Public Health I; PHLT 103: Concepts of Epidemiology

requirementGroups.label: Statistics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: STAT 212: Applied Statistics I (valid until spring 2024) or STAT 180: Introduction to Applied Statistical Methodology (valid beginning fall 2024)

requirementGroups.label: Public health or medical ethics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PHIL 228 (PHIL 228W): Public Health Ethics or PHIL 225: Ethical Decisions in Medicine

requirementGroups.label: Introductory biology
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: BIOL 110: Principles of Biology I or BIOL 112: Perspectives in Biology I; BIOL 111: Principles of Biology II or BIOL 113: Perspectives in Biology II

requirementGroups.label: Introductory chemistry
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: CHEM 131: Chemical Concepts, Systems, and Practices I; CHEM 132: Chemical Concepts, Systems, and Practices II

requirementGroups.label: Environmental health core
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Specific Core Requirements (Five Courses + 1 Credit Lab): EESC 103: Introduction to Environmental Science; PHLT 201W: Environmental Health; CHEM 203: Organic Chemistry I; CHEM 207: Organic Chemistry I: Lab (one credit); CHEM 204: Organic Chemistry II

requirementGroups.label: Genetics
